title: Backend src/ Root Module Ownership & Placement Audit
executive_conclusion: Root-level structure is architecturally valid and intentional. Modules are either application entrypoints (api, startup, ingest), cross-cutting infrastructure (config, logger, errors, health), or retained compatibility facades (db). No module is a misplaced canonical package member warranting relocation.

modules.evidence: FastAPI app factory; imported by start.sh (uvicorn src.api:app), tests/fixtures/client.py, tests/contract/*, tools/development/coVF_discover.py, tools/development/generate_contract_tests.py
Global Settings(); consumed by errors, startup, logger, health, api, core/db/config, tests/fixtures/database
Domain-wide exceptions + register_error_handlers; imported by api and 4 routers + behaviour_service; no core/errors package exists
setup_logging + log_* helpers; consumed by errors, startup, health, behaviour_service; no logging in common/
Application /health + /ready endpoints; registered by api; re-exported (not duplicated) by routers/health.py
run_startup_validation() standalone CLI; not invoked by start.sh (which launches src.api:app). Entrypoint role justifies root.
Parallel PDF ingestion CLI; distinct from import_service/import_router (different DB path, validation, no post-upload pipeline). Only e2e import-presence tests reference it.
Deprecated FinanceDB facade over src.core.db; consumers: common/database.py, tools/generators/generate_synthetic_data.py. Program K migrated fixture consumers.

duplicate_overlap_findings.detail: routers/health.py is a 6-line re-export of root health logic; contains zero logic of its own.

Both implement extract->categorize->store->validate but are separate implementations with different entry contracts (CLI vs HTTP), DB path resolution, and validation heuristics. ingest.py is a parallel/legacy CLI path, not a facade.
config owns application env settings; core/db/config owns canonical DB path. config delegates DB path downward.

dependency_direction.observation: Root modules sit above packages and depend downward (api/startup/ingest -> core/routers/extraction/repositories). No import-time circular dependency. config<->core.db.config uses lazy function-scope imports intentionally.

recommended_next_program.note: No relocation warranted. Root modules are correctly placed.
recommended_next_program.future_program_if_needed: Program M - Controlled Retirement of db.py / common/database.py compatibility facade (distinct from relocation)

no_change_validation.git_status_backend_src: R backend/src/data/finance.db -> backend/src/data/__init__.py (pre-existing Program K rename only)
